title: Trying to recall the Rhythm Club band personnel
summary: Harris struggles to name the band members and dates the job before he joined Henry Harden.

Alton. We had uh... Alton. Alton. We had uh... We had uh... We had uh...

No, we didn't have any trombone. We didn't have a trombone. We didn't have any trombone. You know, just August, the dance I used to get out of the trombone. Yeah, that was way back. Yeah. I don't know if it was. That would have been around about...
